creatives.concept: A woman caught in a candid moment on a hot Tel Aviv street, looking fresh and put-together — the 'how does she stay so cool?' moment.
creatives.visual: Candid street shot, Israeli woman about 50 with wavy dark-brown hair in the blue top, sunglasses pushed up in her hair, crossing a sunny street with a tote bag; natural, not posed.
creatives.prompt: Candid realistic street photograph in Tel Aviv on a hot sunny afternoon. An Israeli woman about 50 with shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair and olive skin and sunglasses pushed up in her hair, crossing a quiet street with a canvas tote bag, wearing the top shown in the reference images in the blue colorway with light jeans. She looks fresh and relaxed. Natural light, realistic skin texture, normal proportions, not glossy advertising. No text in image. Keep the garment exactly as in the reference images; do not add buttons, pockets, prints or details. Casting: a Jewish Israeli woman aged about 50, with a natural Israeli Mediterranean look — warm olive or light-olive skin, dark brown eyes, dark brown to black hair. Not Northern European, not blonde, not an American catalogue model. Any other people in the frame are also Israelis in their 40s to 60s with the same natural Israeli look.

creatives.prompt: Authentic, slightly imperfect photo inside a small Tel Aviv family boutique: a wooden clothing rail with the top from the reference images hanging on wooden hangers in four colorways — blue, green, gray and purple (purple in front). Soft daylight from a shop window, plants, wooden floor. Phone-camera feel, not a studio shot. Empty space on the right for a price card added later. No text in image. Keep the garment design exactly as in the reference images.
